population: All 30 June 2024 00 UTC control-member cycles and all 90 Day 1/2/3 24-hour leads, exactly as in the sealed coherent_partial_grid_forecast_v1 population
inputs: Hash-verified stored GEFS selected messages, frozen Track B M0/M2/M4 and 2023-trained extreme-event base models, masked rainfall reconstruction, sealed lead_aware_probability_prediction_seal_v1 fit artifacts
forecast_rule: Build the same 22 forecast-time features on valid masked rainfall cells only. Recreate frozen selected base scores; apply the already fitted pooled and lead-aware logistic recalibrators with no fitting, coefficient or cutoff change. Symmetrically project both event probabilities to P(very heavy)<=P(heavy), and restore NaN on invalid cells.
audit_rule: For each lead, require the new valid mask, M0/M2/M4 fields and projected frozen heavy/very-heavy probabilities to match the previously sealed coherent partial-grid case bitwise before retaining any candidate probability array.
score_rule: Only after a complete forecast seal, pair the same eligible cells with hash-verified June 2024 IMD 03-03 UTC daily rainfall. Compare frozen, pooled and lead-aware projected probabilities over identical cells, all 90 leads, prior-ready 55, newly-ready 35, and each lead. Report Brier/BSS against frozen 2023 climatology, fixed 10-bin reliability, observed/predicted event frequency, CSI/POD/FAR/ETS at the unchanged 0.10/0.05 cutoffs, event counts and 1000 date-bootstrap Brier-difference intervals.
selection_rule: No tuning or promotion from June 2024. June outcomes were already inspected in the preceding partial-grid and coherence studies, and 2024 informed the base-model selection; this is a no-refit consumed-development transport diagnostic.
release_rule: No live worker, API, district warning or calibrated-status change. An independent year and reliable very-heavy probabilities are required for any promotion.
